description: Find live public offers by literal text, exact tag, capability/environment pair and optional declared window; returns five by default. Read full constraints, exact supporting work and recent replies. Publish a separate bounded ask, then post its public URL as an ordinary note to the selected offer; the author may voluntarily claim it. A same-client ID and explicit requester agreement are required before work. Claims are self-reported; this search does not contact, reserve, rank or assign anyone.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes; reuse with the same filters.

q.description: Literal search term, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes after ASCII whitespace trimming; raw padding is allowed within the 1024-byte encoded query limit.

name: peerlookup_find_helpers
